# Plotting of Deconvolution data -- immune & macrophage composition

#===================================================================
# MERGE NOTE (this pass): this script combines two earlier versions.
# One version had simple violin plots + mixed-effects (lmer) modelling
# of immune/macrophage signal by nerve category. A later version
# replaced those violin plots with a more thorough spot-level vs
# nerve-level comparison (same visual language, aggregated two ways),
# but in doing so DROPPED the lmer statistical modelling entirely --
# this looks like an oversight from refactoring the plots, not a
# deliberate decision to remove the statistics, so both are kept here:
# the newer spot/nerve-level plots AND the lmer models. The two
# versions also both contained an IDENTICAL "common tail" (per-nerve
# RCTD reshaping, individual-nerve plot, heatmap, NMF composition by
# category) -- kept once here, not duplicated.
#
# THIS SCRIPT ONLY GENERATES FIGURES/STATISTICAL SUMMARIES -- it reads
# already-computed RCTD_weights.Rds, NMFcomp.csv, and the frozen nerve
# identification columns; it never recomputes any of those. Safe to
# re-run as often as needed.
#
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT PRODUCES
# --------------------------
# Figures (output/06_deconvolution/figures/):
#   - exploratory_violin_adaptive_immune.pdf
#       Adaptive immune (T/NK) + plasma cell proportions, single violin
#       per nerve category (original, simple version).
#   - exploratory_violin_myeloid_NMF.pdf
#       Macrophage-associated NMF program scores, same simple style.
#   - exploratory_immune_composition_spot_level.pdf / exploratory_immune_composition_nerve_level.pdf
#       Same immune signals, shown both at spot level and aggregated to
#       one point per nerve (newer, more thorough version).
#   - exploratory_macrophage_nmf_spot_level.pdf / exploratory_macrophage_nmf_nerve_level.pdf
#       Same for macrophage NMF programs.
#   - exploratory_combined_immune_macrophage_nerve_level.pdf
#       All 4 nerve-level panels (immune + macrophage) together.
#   - FigureS6G_individual_nerve_deconvolution_3cat.pdf
#       Full RCTD cell-type composition per individual nerve.
#   - exploratory_nerves_mean_composition_by_cat3.pdf
#       Mean RCTD composition per nerve category (3-category scheme).
#   - FigureS6F_heatmap_deconvolution_cat3_nerves.pdf
#       Enrichment z-score heatmap, cell type x 3-category scheme.
#   - exploratory_nerves_mean_composition_NMF_by_cat3.pdf
#       Mean NMF-program composition per nerve category.
#
# Anything named "exploratory_" is not in the manuscript.
#
# Tables (output/06_deconvolution/tables/):
#   - lmer_immune_models_summary.txt
#       Mixed-effects model summaries for plasma-cell and adaptive-
#       T/NK proportions by nerve category (patient + NerveID random
#       effects).
#   - lmer_macrophage_nmf_models_summary.txt
#       Same, for the macrophage and C1q-macrophage NMF programs.
#===================================================================

```{r}
#=================================
#1. Load Libraries and input data
#================================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(pheatmap)
library(lme4)

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "06_deconvolution"
TABLES_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "figures")
dir.create(TABLES_DIR,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

c25 <- c(
  "dodgerblue2", "#E31A1C", "green4", "#6A3D9A", "#FF7F00",
  "black", "gold1", "skyblue2", "#FB9A99", "palegreen2",
  "#CAB2D6", "#FDBF6F", "gray70", "khaki2",
  "maroon", "orchid1", "deeppink1", "blue1", "steelblue4",
  "darkturquoise", "green1", "yellow4", "yellow3",
  "darkorange4", "brown"
)

# ---- Frozen inputs: never recomputed here ------------------------------
spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "DE_SPE_annotaion.csv")))
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode

W_df <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "RCTD_weights.Rds"))
weights_df_copy <- W_df
```

```{r}
#==========================================
# 2. Identify nerve spots and define groups
#==========================================

nerve_mask <- colData(spe)$is.nerve == TRUE

nerve_meta_df <- data.frame(
  barcode     = as.character(spe$barcode[nerve_mask]),
  patient_id  = as.factor(colData(spe)$patient_id[nerve_mask]),
  NerveID     = as.factor(colData(spe)$NerveID[nerve_mask]),
  Invaded     = as.character(colData(spe)$Invaded[nerve_mask]),
  type_raw    = as.character(colData(spe)$type[nerve_mask])
)

nerve_meta_df$types_grouped <- ifelse(
  nerve_meta_df$type_raw == "noPNI",
  "Adjacent",
  "Diseased"
)

nerve_meta_df$nerve_category <- ifelse(
  nerve_meta_df$Invaded == "NonInvaded",
  paste0("NonInvaded_", nerve_meta_df$types_grouped),
  nerve_meta_df$Invaded
)

nerve_meta_df <- nerve_meta_df[!is.na(nerve_meta_df$nerve_category), ]

analysis_df <- nerve_meta_df %>%
  left_join(weights_df_copy, by = "barcode")
```

## Part A -- simple violin plots + mixed-effects modelling (original version)

```{r}
#===============================================
# 3. Compute immune composition summary metrics
#===============================================

immune_df <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(
    Adaptive_T_NK =
      coalesce(`Lymphocyte(CD4)`, 0) +
      coalesce(`Lymphocyte(CD8)`, 0) +
      coalesce(`Lymphocyte(NK)`, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(
    barcode,
    patient_id,
    NerveID,
    nerve_category,
    `B_cells_(Plasma_cells)`,
    Adaptive_T_NK
  )
```

```{r}
#=====================================================
# 4. Plot adaptive immune and plasma cell proportions
#=====================================================

immune_long <- immune_df %>%
  mutate(
    nerve_category = factor(
      nerve_category,
      levels = c("NonInvaded_Adjacent", "NonInvaded_Diseased", "Invaded")
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      `B_cells_(Plasma_cells)`,
      Adaptive_T_NK
    ),
    names_to = "CellType",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  )

immune_long$patient_id <- factor(immune_long$patient_id, levels = c("54703","6249","70865"))

p_violin <- ggplot(immune_long, aes(x = nerve_category, y = Proportion)) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = TRUE, scale = "width",
    fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.8, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "grey80", color = "grey30", alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = patient_id),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 1),
    size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ CellType, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "RCTD proportion", color = "Patient")

p_violin
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_violin_adaptive_immune.pdf"), p_violin, width = 6, height = 3, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
#=============================================
# 5. Mixed-effects modelling of immune signals
#=============================================

logit_transform <- function(p, eps = 1e-4) {
  p <- pmax(eps, pmin(1 - eps, p))
  log(p / (1 - p))
}

run_lmer_model <- function(celltype_name) {

  tmp <- immune_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(nerve_category)) %>%
    mutate(
      prop_logit = logit_transform(.data[[celltype_name]])
    )

  fit <- lmer(
    prop_logit ~ nerve_category +
      (1 | patient_id) +
      (1 | NerveID),
    data = tmp
  )

  summary(fit)
}

res_plasma <- run_lmer_model("B_cells_(Plasma_cells)")
res_lymph  <- run_lmer_model("Adaptive_T_NK")
print(res_plasma)
print(res_lymph)

# Persist the model summaries, not just console output
sink(file.path(TABLES_DIR, "lmer_immune_models_summary.txt"))
cat("=== Plasma cells (B_cells_(Plasma_cells)) ~ nerve_category + (1|patient_id) + (1|NerveID) ===\n")
print(res_plasma)
cat("\n=== Adaptive T/NK ~ nerve_category + (1|patient_id) + (1|NerveID) ===\n")
print(res_lymph)
sink()
```

```{r}
#====================================================
# 9. Mixed-effects modelling of NMF program activity
#====================================================

run_lmer_nmf <- function(program_name) {

  tmp <- nmf_analysis_df %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id, NerveID, nerve_category, all_of(program_name)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(score = all_of(program_name)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(score), !is.na(nerve_category))

  fit <- lmer(
    score ~ nerve_category +
      (1 | patient_id) +
      (1 | NerveID),
    data = tmp
  )

  return(fit)
}

fit_myeloid <- run_lmer_nmf("Myeloid(Macrophages)")
fit_c1q     <- run_lmer_nmf("Myeloid(C1q_macrophages)")

print(summary(fit_myeloid))
print(summary(fit_c1q))

sink(file.path(TABLES_DIR, "lmer_macrophage_nmf_models_summary.txt"))
cat("=== Macrophage NMF program ~ nerve_category + (1|patient_id) + (1|NerveID) ===\n")
print(summary(fit_myeloid))
cat("\n=== C1q-macrophage NMF program ~ nerve_category + (1|patient_id) + (1|NerveID) ===\n")
print(summary(fit_c1q))
sink()
```

## Part B -- spot-level vs nerve-level comparison plots (newer version)

```{r}
#=====================================================
# 10. Compute immune composition metrics per spot
#=====================================================

immune_spot_df <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(
    Adaptive_T_NK =
      coalesce(`Lymphocyte(CD4)`, 0) +
      coalesce(`Lymphocyte(CD8)`, 0) +
      coalesce(`Lymphocyte(NK)`, 0),
    Plasma_B = coalesce(`B_cells_(Plasma_cells)`, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(
    barcode,
    patient_id,
    NerveID,
    nerve_category,
    Plasma_B,
    Adaptive_T_NK
  )
```

```{r}
#=====================================================
# 11. Set plotting order and labels
#=====================================================

nerve_order <- c("NonInvaded_Adjacent", "NonInvaded_Diseased", "Invaded")
patient_order <- c("54703", "6249", "70865")

celltype_order <- c("Adaptive_T_NK", "Plasma_B")
celltype_labels <- c(
  "Adaptive_T_NK" = "Adaptive T/NK cells",
  "Plasma_B"      = "B/plasma cells"
)

patient_cols <- c(
  "54703" = "#d95f02",
  "6249"  = "#1b9e77",
  "70865" = "#7570b3"
)
```

```{r}
#=====================================================
# 12. Prepare spot-level long table
#=====================================================

immune_spot_long <- immune_spot_df %>%
  mutate(
    nerve_category = factor(nerve_category, levels = nerve_order),
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = patient_order)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Adaptive_T_NK, Plasma_B),
    names_to = "CellType",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CellType = factor(CellType, levels = celltype_order),
    CellTypeLabel = factor(celltype_labels[as.character(CellType)],
                           levels = unname(celltype_labels[celltype_order]))
  )
```

```{r}
#=====================================================
# 13. Aggregate from spot level to nerve level
#=====================================================

immune_nerve_long <- immune_spot_long %>%
  group_by(NerveID, patient_id, nerve_category, CellType, CellTypeLabel) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanProportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_spots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    nerve_category = factor(nerve_category, levels = nerve_order),
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = patient_order)
  )
```

```{r}
#=====================================================

p_immune_spot <- ggplot(
```

## Part C -- common tail: full RCTD/NMF composition by 3-category scheme (identical in both earlier versions, kept once)

```{r}
#==============================================
# 18. Reshape RCTD weights to spot-level format
#==============================================

rctd_cols <- c(
  "Acinar", "B_cells", "CAF", "Lymphocyte(CD4)", "Lymphocyte(CD8)",
  "Ductal_malignant", "Ductal_normal", "Endocrine", "Endothelial",
  "Myeloid", "Lymphocyte(NK)", "B_cells_(Plasma_cells)", "Schwann", "Stellate"
)

dfp_spot <- analysis_df %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, patient_id, NerveID, nerve_category, dplyr::all_of(rctd_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(rctd_cols), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "pct") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    barcode = as.character(barcode),
    NerveID = as.character(NerveID),
    patient_id = factor(as.character(patient_id), levels = c("54703", "6249", "70865")),
    nerve_category = factor(as.character(nerve_category), levels = c("NonInvaded_Adjacent", "NonInvaded_Diseased", "Invaded"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(nerve_category), !is.na(NerveID))
```

```{r}
#====================================================
# 23. Compute heatmap of cell type enrichment scores
#====================================================

categories <- dfp_spot %>%
  dplyr::distinct(barcode, nerve_category) %>%
  dplyr::rename(category = nerve_category) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    barcode = as.character(barcode),
    category = factor(as.character(category), levels = c("NonInvaded_Adjacent", "NonInvaded_Diseased", "Invaded"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(category))

cats <- levels(droplevels(categories$category))

wide <- dfp_spot %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, CellType, pct) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = CellType, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0)

W_mat <- as.data.frame(wide)
rownames(W_mat) <- W_mat$barcode
W_mat$barcode <- NULL

keep_bcs <- intersect(rownames(W_mat), categories$barcode)
W_mat <- W_mat[keep_bcs, , drop = FALSE]
categories <- categories %>% dplyr::filter(barcode %in% keep_bcs)

enrichment_z <- function(vec, group, target_cat) {
  bcs_in <- group$barcode[group$category == target_cat]
  x_in <- vec[bcs_in]
  mu_in <- mean(x_in, na.rm = TRUE)
  mu_all <- mean(vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- stats::sd(vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(s) || s == 0) return(NA_real_)
  (mu_in - mu_all) / s
}

cell_types <- colnames(W_mat)

z_mat <- sapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  v <- setNames(W_mat[, ct], rownames(W_mat))
  sapply(cats, function(ca) enrichment_z(v, categories, ca))
})

rownames(z_mat) <- c("Adjacent", "NonInvaded\nDiseased", "Invaded")

p_hm <- pheatmap(
  z_mat,
  cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE, scale = "none",
  color = colorRampPalette(c(c25[1], "white", c25[2]))(100),
  fontsize_row = 11, fontsize_col = 8, angle_col = 45, border_color = NA,
  filename = file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS6F_heatmap_deconvolution_cat3_nerves.pdf"),
  width = 12, height = 6
)

p_hm
```

```{r}
nmf_cols <- c(
  "CAF", "Ductal_malignant", "B_cells", "Endocrine", "Acinar", "Ductal_normal",
  "Myeloid(Macrophages)", "Myeloid(C1q_macrophages)", "Lymphocytes",
  "Adipocytes", "Muscle", "Endothelial", "Nerve"
)

compk30_df$barcode <- as.character(compk30_df$barcode)

nmf_joined <- nerve_meta_df %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, patient_id, NerveID, nerve_category) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    barcode = as.character(barcode),
    NerveID = as.character(NerveID),
    patient_id = factor(as.character(patient_id), levels = c("54703", "6249", "70865")),
    nerve_category = factor(as.character(nerve_category), levels = c("NonInvaded_Adjacent", "NonInvaded_Diseased", "Invaded"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(compk30_df %>% dplyr::select(barcode, dplyr::all_of(nmf_cols)), by = "barcode")

nmf_long2 <- nmf_joined %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(nmf_cols), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "val") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(val = as.numeric(val)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(nerve_category)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(barcode) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * val / sum(val, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

avg_cat_nmf <- nmf_long2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(nerve_category, CellType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(pct = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

avg_cat_nmf$nerve_category_plot[avg_cat_nmf$nerve_category_plot == "NonInvaded_Adjacent"] <- "Adjacent"

avg_cat_nmf$nerve_category_plot[avg_cat_nmf$nerve_category_plot == "Invaded"] <- "Invaded"
avg_cat_nmf$nerve_category_plot <- factor(avg_cat_nmf$nerve_category_plot, levels = c("Adjacent", "NonInvaded\nDiseased", "Invaded"))

celltypes_present <- avg_cat_nmf %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pct), pct > 0) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(CellType) %>%
  dplyr::pull(CellType)

avg_cat_nmf <- avg_cat_nmf %>% dplyr::filter(CellType %in% celltypes_present)

pal_present <- color_maping[intersect(names(color_maping), celltypes_present)]
avg_cat_nmf$CellType <- factor(avg_cat_nmf$CellType, levels = names(pal_present))

p_cat1 <- ggplot(avg_cat_nmf, aes(y = nerve_category_plot, x = pct, fill = CellType)) +

  ) +
```
